'''Gabriel Omar Ramírez''' (born 29 June 1995) is an Argentine professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[Chaco For Ever]].<ref>[http://aelfc.gr/anakoinoseis-menu/item/3895-anakoinosi ] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220107184659/http://aelfc.gr/anakoinoseis-menu/item/3895-anakoinosi |date=7 January 2022 }} at aelfc.gr</ref>

==Career==
Ramírez started in the youth ranks of [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]], which preceded a short spell in 2015 with [[Talleres de Córdoba|Talleres]]' academy prior to rejoining Lanús.<ref name="Joined Talleres 1">{{cite news|title=Gabriel Ramírez, una apuesta de Talleres al mediocampo|url=http://mundod.lavoz.com.ar/futbol/gabriel-ramirez-una-apuesta-de-talleres-al-mediocampo|accessdate=19 March 2018|work=Mundod Lavoz|date=21 January 2015}}</ref> He scored two goals <!--Soccerway say one - incorrect--> in five games for the Lanús U20s at the [[2016 U-20 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="Soccerway profile">{{cite news|title=Gabriel Ramírez profile|url=https://int.soccerway.com/players/gabriel-omar-ramirez/433297/|accessdate=19 March 2018|work=Soccerway|date=19 March 2018}}</ref> In July 2016, Ramírez was loaned to fellow [[Argentine Primera División]] side [[Quilmes Atlético Club|Quilmes]].<ref name="Soccerway profile"/> He made his professional debut on 17 September during a 1–1 draw with [[Club Atlético Independiente|Independiente]].<ref name="Soccerway profile"/> In the following December, he scored the first two goals of his senior career in league matches against [[Club Atlético Sarmiento (Junín)|Sarmiento]] and [[Club Atlético Temperley|Temperley]].<ref name="Soccerway profile"/><ref name="BDFA profile">{{cite news|title=Gabriel Ramírez profile|url=http://www.bdfa.com.ar/jugadores-GABRIEL-OMAR-RAMIREZ-109127.html|accessdate=19 March 2018|work=BDFA|date=19 March 2018}}</ref> In total, Ramírez featured twenty-two times for Quilmes.<ref name="Soccerway profile"/> He returned to Lanús in 2017.<ref name="Soccerway profile"/><ref name="Lanús">{{cite news|title=Ramírez: Voy a dejar todo porque es el club que amo|url=http://www.clublanus.com/secciones/futbol-profesional/noticias/ramirez-voy-a-dejar-todo-porque-es-el-club-que-amo|accessdate=19 March 2018|work=Club Atlético Lanús|date=24 July 2017}}</ref>

He was again loaned out two months later to rejoin Talleres.<ref name="Joined Talleres 2">{{cite news|title=Gabriel Ramírez es refuerzo de Talleres para la Superliga|url=http://www.clubtalleres.com.ar/gabriel-ramirez-es-refuerzo-de-talleres-para-la-superliga/|accessdate=19 March 2018|work=Talleres de Córdoba|date=23 August 2017|archive-date=19 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180319151428/http://www.clubtalleres.com.ar/gabriel-ramirez-es-refuerzo-de-talleres-para-la-superliga/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Six appearances followed prior to his departure in December.<ref name="Soccerway profile"/> In January 2018, Ramírez rejoined Quilmes, now of [[Primera B Nacional]], on loan.<ref name="Soccerway profile"/><ref name="Joined Quilmes 2">{{cite news|title=Quilmes cuenta con el regreso de Gabriel Ramírez|url=https://www.diariopopular.com.ar/quilmes-cuenta-el-regreso-gabriel-ramirez-n339650|accessdate=19 March 2018|work=Diario Popular|date=26 January 2018}}</ref> His first appearance of [[2017–18 Primera B Nacional|2017–18]] arrived in a tie versus [[Club Agropecuario Argentino|Agropecuario]] on 5 February.<ref name="Soccerway profile"/> [[Atlético de Rafaela]] signed Ramírez on a loan deal in the following July.<ref name="Soccerway profile"/>
